description: The scenario matrix of the benchmarks. Every runner (React Native, Tehreer-Android, Tehreer-Cocoa) reads this file. A scenario's text is its segments, in order, repeated `repeat` times; a segment's text is styled with its font and the scenario's typeSize. `characters` is the length in UTF-16 code units (a test checks it). Lengths are layout units, one unit is one pixel (render scale 1).

metrics.layoutMs: Typesetter creation plus FrameResolver creation plus frame creation from a prepared styled text; objects are released outside the timer.
metrics.drawMs: One draw of the frame onto an offscreen canvas of the platform, with the wrapper's native painter, canvas created once and not cleared between draws; only the draw call is timed.
metrics.memLayoutKB: Native heap in use (malloc) after a typesetter and a frame are alive, minus before the styled text was made; median of three. Tehreer-Android adds its Java heap (after a collection) because it keeps part of the layout there.
